metadata.description: ORTEX short-selling and market data for Claude.

plugins.name: ortex
plugins.description:
ORTEX short-selling and market data in Claude, for investors, traders and analysts with an ORTEX account.

Ask in plain English about a stock, a watchlist or an ETF: short interest and its share of free float, cost to borrow, days to cover, shares available to borrow, the ORTEX short score, exchange-reported short interest and European short filings. Also options chains, Greeks and put/call ratios, ORTEX stock scores, peers, US government (Congress) trades, fundamentals, prices, free float, splits, earnings and macro calendars, and ETF holdings and holders. 34 read-only tools.

A bundled analyst skill shows Claude how to read short-selling data together and present a short verdict with the evidence and its as-of date.

Everything is read-only. ORTEX never places trades or moves money, and it does not give personal investment advice. The data you can reach is what your ORTEX plan includes.
